blocks.text: Cloudstone holds a little weather between brackets. The name is a practical Era Four compound for an object whose older environmental associations are larger than its present care function.
A small layered ochre cloud fossil clamped between two dark teal crescent brackets with pale lilac core.
One-shot use: The front plate opens fully and a large pale cloud expands out of the exposed core. The game performs the final fade.
14 silver. Exhaustion severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Energy +8; Health +3. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image cd89e677-c2aa-4eca-91d9-76ab3e29dcc7; animation 01891845-ada2-41df-9c96-aee61fd92576. Reduced motion holds a still.
